description: Find real lines (lyrics, proverbs, sayings) that end with a rhyme on the given word. Useful as inspiration for the next line of a verse.

language.description: Language code. Supported: af, ar, az, bg, bs, ca, cs, cy, da, de, el, en-us, eo, es, es_lat, et, eu, fa, fi, fr, fr_be, fr_ch, hi, hr, hu, hy, hy_arevmda, id, it, ka, kn, ko, la, lt, lv, mk, ml, ms, nl, no, pl, pt, pt_br, ro, ru, sk, sl, sq, sr, sv, ta, te, tr, ur, vi, zh ("en" = "en-us").

vocabulary.description: "rap" uses rap lyrics (de and en only), "general" uses proverbs and general texts.

word.description: Word the lines should rhyme with.

name: find_rhyming_lines
title: Find rhyming lines
